description: Facilitated PRD workflow — create a new PRD via coached discovery, update an existing one against a change signal, or validate a finished PRD against a checklist with an HTML findings report.
Guidance through realizing the plan for your UX, strongly recommended if a UI is a primary piece of the proposed project.

Set up or refresh a repo's agent instructions so AI agents work well in it: verified commands, policy, conventions that differ from defaults, and known pitfalls. Setup, refresh, record, and audit — replaces document-project and generate-project-context.

Use to distill any intent input (brief, PRD, transcript, brain dump, design folder, mixed multi-source) into a succinct, no-fluff SPEC.md contract + companions that downstream work derives from. Locks the WHAT before the HOW. Works for software, game design, research, editorial, policy, business, anything intent-bearing. Validation mode also available.
Navigate significant changes. May recommend start over update PRD redo architecture sprint planning or correct epics and stories.
Anytime: summarize sprint status with risks open action items and the next recommended action; can also validate or repair the tracking file.
Expert guided facilitation through a single or multiple techniques.
An expert guided experience to nail down your product idea in a brief. a gentler approach than PRFAQ when you are already sure of your concept and nothing will sway you.

Working Backwards guided experience to forge and stress-test your product concept to ensure you have a great product that users will love and need through the PRFAQ gauntlet to determine feasibility and alignment with user needs. alternative to product brief.

Offer once requirements exist (a PRD or spec; plus UX if present) and the user is ready to move from what to how. Also offer any time independently-built parts risk diverging. Produces the architecture spine: the invariants that keep features epics and stories consistent. Comes before epics and stories and scales from a quick spine to a full architecture (brownfield: ratifies the existing codebase).
Readiness gate then tracking: verifies the planning is implementable (PASS/CONCERNS/FAIL) and produces the sprint status the implementation agents follow for every story.
Official Phase 4 implementation loop: clarify intent plan implement review and present.
Ad hoc review of any code change. Optional extra layer after Build's built-in review.
Guided walkthrough of a change from purpose and context into details. Use for human review of commits branches or PRs.
Generate automated API and E2E tests for implemented code. NOT for code review or story validation — use CR for that.
Optional at epic end: Review completed work lessons learned and next epic or if major issues consider CC.
Use early in ideation or when stuck generating ideas.
Orchestrate multi-agent discussions when you need multiple perspectives or want agents to collaborate.

Use when you want to change how an agent or workflow behaves — add persistent facts, swap templates, insert activation hooks, or customize menus. Scans what's customizable, picks the right scope (agent vs workflow), writes the override to _bmad/custom/, and verifies the merge. No TOML hand-authoring required.

Use at any checkpoint to push a just-produced draft, section, or plan past its first version — pick from a menu of elicitation methods (pre-mortem, first principles, red team, socratic) and apply the improvements.

Use to review anything before it ships — a diff, branch, or uncommitted changes; a PRD, spec, story, or architecture doc; any prose document. Runs whichever installed lenses fit the content and reports findings in one shape: shipped lenses cover adversarial critique, edge cases, verification gaps, document structure (cuts, merges, moves), and prose copy-edit, and installs may add more. Reach for it to tighten a bloated or LLM-slop draft, pressure-test a plan before building, or check a change is adequately tested. Run every applicable lens or name the ones you want. Code Review in other modules calls it automatically.

Use to pressure-test and harden an idea — software, business, creative, research, or life — until it proves out, hardens into something buildable, or dies cheaply. Persona-driven interrogation; optional handoff to bmad-spec or bmad-build.

Decision-grade research three ways: draft a deep-research prompt for your own AI tool then process the returned report into a downstream-ready cited summary — or run the research directly via web fan-out. Types: market domain technical competitive user-voice academic-lit plus a select shape for choose-between decisions; claim verification and refresh lifecycle. Custom types via overrides.

Deploy model as Vetiver API with Docker container and monitoring setup.
Load datasets and run initial quality checks — detect types missing values and structural issues before cleaning.
Systematic tidyverse wrangling — handle missings outliers encodings and document every decision in sidecar memory.
Complete systematic exploratory data analysis with ggplot2 visualizations and statistical summaries.
Guided feature creation using tidymodels recipes — encoding transformations interactions and selection.
Baseline plus systematic model comparison with tidymodels — cross-validation and performance tables.
Standard hyperparameter tuning 10-50 iterations using grid search or Bayesian optimization.
Deep optimization 50-200 iterations with Bayesian racing methods and ensembles for maximum performance.
Final test set evaluation — runs ONCE at the end to produce honest performance estimates.
Generate comprehensive 30-page Quarto report with full methodology results and reproducible code.
Generate 2-3 page executive summary with key insights and actionable recommendations.
Create interactive Shiny dashboard with KPIs drill-downs and reactive visualizations.
Install and configure the RDS module — registers 4 agents and sets project paths for workflows templates and memory.
